snippet.title: Gemini X Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Gemini X is a single player action-exploration platformer that blends the familiarity of the metroidvania genre with run-and-gun combat inspired by games from the 32-bit era.

Wishlist NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4360760/GeminiX/
